results.description:
Big life changes do not start big. They start with one small habit, done today, done again tomorrow. HabitKit turns those daily wins into a colorful grid of tiles, one square for every day you show up, so you can finally see yourself becoming the person you want to be.

That visible progress is the whole secret behind HabitKit, a beautifully simple habit tracker. When your grid looks this good, you will not want to stop. Fill the tiles, protect your streak, and let consistency do the heavy lifting.

Whether you want to work out more, read every night, meditate, drink more water, save money, or finally quit smoking, HabitKit gives every goal the same simple loop: do it, log it, watch the grid grow. No guilt trips, just daily habit tracking that feels rewarding.

BUILD GOOD HABITS, QUIT BAD ONES
Create the habits you want to grow, or flip it around and quit a habit: every day counts as clean until you log a slip, and your streak counts your clean days in a row. You can even set a daily maximum, like two coffees a day, and simply stay under it instead of going cold turkey.

TRACK YOUR HABITS YOUR WAY
Check a day off with a simple yes or no, count reps like glasses or pages, or measure amounts with your own unit, like 2 L of water or 7.5 km of running. Set daily goals and flexible schedules that fit your routine: every day, specific intervals, or a number of times per week or month.

YOUR PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
Every habit gets its own tile grid, like a contribution graph, and every completed day fills in a square. See all your habits together on one dashboard, switch between Classic, Compact, and Split views, and share a beautiful snapshot of your progress when you hit a milestone. One glance tells you the whole story: what you did, what you missed, and how far you have come.

WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
Put your favorite habits right on your home screen with small, medium, and multi-habit widgets. Your grids stay in sight, so your goals stay on your mind. Widgets follow your theme too, all the way to pure black dark mode.

REMINDERS AT THE RIGHT TIME
Get a friendly nudge exactly when you need it, and never forget a habit again. Add a daily check-in to review your whole day, and with Pro, up to three reminders per habit.

STATISTICS, STREAKS, AND NOTES
Watch your current streak grow, chase your best streak, and set streak goals for extra motivation. Dive into completion statistics and monthly charts, manage past days in the calendar, and add a short note to any day: what went well, what got in the way.

MAKE IT YOURS
Give every habit its own color and icon, or use any emoji. Organize your dashboard with categories and filters, reorder everything with drag and drop, and pick light, dark, or system theme, including a pure black mode for OLED screens.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No ads. Your habit data stays on your device, and the app works completely offline.

HABITKIT PRO
HabitKit is free to use with up to four habits, including streaks, statistics, notes, and reminders. Pro unlocks unlimited habits, home screen widgets, import and export backups, restoring archived habits, and up to three reminders per habit. Subscribe monthly or yearly, or pay once and keep Pro forever with the lifetime option. Every upgrade supports an independent developer. Start free, see if the grid pulls you in, and upgrade whenever you are ready.

You do not need a new life. You need one small habit and a place to see it grow. Download HabitKit and place your first tile today.

Privacy Policy: https://www.habitkit.app/privacy/

results.description:
You've checked the boxes. The day still didn't happen.

Routinery tracks your routines and then runs them with you.

App of the Day 2026 (Apple) - Best ADHD App of 2025 (Forbes Health) - 5 million downloads

A habit tracker, routine tracker and day planner in one. Stack small habits into a daily routine, break it into 1-5 minute steps, and each step runs on its own timer while a voice calls out what comes next.

Morning routines, bedtime wind-downs, study blocks, workouts, medication - anything with a fixed order runs the same way.

WHY IT WORKS
- Starting gets easier. "Study" is too big to begin; "sit at the desk, 1 min" is not. Small steps lower the cost of the first move.
- Nothing to decide mid-run. You set the order once, when you built the routine. Nothing left to choose means less to stall on.
- Wins come back often. A finish is logged every step, not once a day.
- No time math. You set each step's length once. Sink into one thing and the voice pulls you out, so an afternoon doesn't vanish.

ASK CHATGPT OR CLAUDE TO BUILD IT
- "Make me a 40-minute weekday morning routine" and it lands in the app.
- Your assistant can handle routines alongside other tools you've connected there, like Google Calendar.
- Connects to ChatGPT, Claude and others over our MCP server, included in the free plan.

IT STARTS ON TIME, SCREEN OR NOT
- Set the weekdays and time; the reminder arrives then. Weekdays only, three times a week, whatever your schedule.
- The voice reads each step aloud, so the routine keeps running while you shower or cook.
- A home screen widget shows today's list without opening the app.
- Start on the phone, carry on from watch, tablet, or Mac.

STAY DEEP IN ONE THING
- A pomodoro that announces the next task, so the block keeps its own momentum.
- Build the environment: white noise, Focus mode, landscape view, Shortcuts.
- Stretch a timer, skip a step, reorder what's left - all without leaving the run.

DON'T DO IT ALONE
- Share a routine's task list with family or a friend and see how far each of you got.
- Finish a routine and the result goes straight to the person you picked.

SEE IT ADD UP
- A plant grows for each day you keep a streak; weekly and monthly stats show what holds.

FOR THE DAILY AND THE ONE-OFF
- Keep undated tasks and weekly repeats in one daily routine planner.
- A one-time task gets a timer too.
- Can't face it now? Park it in Anytime for later.
- Shift work that moves weekly still fits: Morning, Afternoon, Evening.
- See the day as a list, a calendar, or a timeline.

WHO USES ROUTINERY
- Adults with ADHD who know the task and still can't start
- People who lose hours once they sink into something
- People who double-check in case they missed one
- Anyone who waits to start until they can do it perfectly
- Shift workers, people on daily medication, parents on the school run
- Anyone who wrote a routine down and never once ran it

ROUTINERY AT A GLANCE

Is Routinery free?
Yes. 2 routines free, no account, first one running in under a minute. Premium lifts the routine cap: monthly, 6-month or yearly. The free plan shows ads; Premium is ad-free.

Do I need an account, and what about privacy?
No account, no sign-up. Routine data is stored on our servers; usage analytics go through third-party tools. What you type is never used to train AI models. Email hello@routinery.app and we delete your data.

Does Routinery work offline?
Almost entirely. Routines, timers, voice, reminders and history run offline. Only device sync needs a connection.

What does Routinery connect to?
Siri Shortcuts, widgets, Apple Watch, and AI assistants over MCP. No direct sync with Apple Health or calendars. No export button either; pull your data out over MCP instead, free plan included.

What devices does Routinery run on?
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. No web version.

Questions, bugs or ideas: hello@routinery.app

Routinery is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat ADHD.

A workout rep. A bird at the feeder. A row of knitting. A page read. A prayer bead. Anything you'd otherwise mark on the back of an envelope.

WHAT PEOPLE COUNT

• Workout reps and sets
• Knitting rows and stitches
• Prayer beads and rosaries
• Pages read, books finished
• Birds at the feeder
• Days sober, days run, days anything
• Cups of water, cups of tea


A BOOK OF PAGES

WHERE IT GOES WITH YOU

• A small widget: tap + to add a tally without opening the app.
• A large widget: a whole journal at a glance.
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Tally push-ups in Tallies."
• Your counts sync across iPhone, iPad and Mac through your private iCloud.


ON PAPER, DAY AND NIGHT

Built for everyone: VoiceOver, Voice Control, Switch Control, Larger Text (tap the counter to magnify), Reduced Motion, Sufficient Contrast and Differentiate Without Color. In English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese and Korean.


FREE TO START, UNLOCK ONCE

One journal with two items is free, for as long as you like. When you want more, unlock the full app once. It follows your Apple Account to your iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscription, no ads, no sign-up.


PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

Nothing leaves your iCloud. No sign-in, no analytics, no ads, no third-party SDKs.

Every day you keep a habit turns one square green. Skip a week and you see the gap. That is the whole idea: a year of your life on one screen, honest and impossible to argue with.

HeatMap is a habit tracker built around the GitHub-style contribution grid. Open it, tap once, done. No cluttered dashboard, no ads, no guilt-tripping notifications.

THREE WAYS TO TRACK
- Yes / No — did you go to the gym today?
- Counter — pages read, glasses of water, cups of coffee.
- Timer — start it and log real minutes of practice, study or meditation.
Set a daily target, or a gentler one like "4 times a week", and the grid follows your rule instead of shaming you for a rest day.

STATISTICS THAT ACTUALLY TELL YOU SOMETHING
- Current streak, personal record, total days
- Your most productive weekday, and weekdays vs weekends
- Six-month trend, month-over-month change and a year-end projection
- Your longest gaps, so you can see where a habit usually breaks
Tap any number to open the full chart behind it.

RIGHT ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets showing your live heatmap
- A Control Center button to log a habit without opening the app
- Siri Shortcuts: "Hey Siri, mark meditation"

WORKS OFFLINE, SYNCS WHEN YOU WANT
Start tracking immediately — no account, no email, no onboarding quiz. Everything is stored on your device and keeps working on a plane or underground. Sign in later and your existing habits move with you to iPhone, iPad and the web, in both directions, with nothing lost.

MADE TO BE LOOKED AT EVERY DAY
Twelve hand-picked colour palettes, icons for every kind of habit, full light and dark themes, and a calm interface that gets out of your way. Available in English, Russian, Spanish, German, French, Chinese and Japanese.

GOOD FOR
Gym and workouts, running, reading, meditation, language learning, drinking water, journaling, practising an instrument, quitting smoking, cutting screen time, side projects, deep work, medication, skincare.

FREE, WITH NO CATCH
Track habits with every colour palette and the complete set of statistics — free. No ads, no paywall standing in front of your own charts, no trial that quietly starts charging you.

results.description:
You've done this before. You started strong, you missed a Tuesday, and the app made sure you knew it. The number went back to zero, and you stopped opening it a few days later. That's not a discipline problem. That's an app that only knew how to keep score.

HabitScript keeps the whole picture instead. The water you drank. The ten minutes on the mat. The twenty pages before bed, the phone left in the kitchen. Miss a Tuesday and Tuesday is just a day — everything else you did is still there, still yours, still visible.

AS MANY HABITS AS YOUR LIFE HAS

Other apps let you have three, maybe five, then ask for money. HabitScript doesn't count your habits. Add the one you're serious about and the small one you're embarrassed about. Add the one you'll drop in a week. Free means free.

NOTHING TO PROTECT, NOTHING TO LOSE

There's no fragile number you owe the app. Nothing scolds you, nothing resets to zero, and nobody's disappointed in you on Thursday morning. Come back after a bad week and you'll find the good weeks still sitting there.

IT'S YOURS, AND IT STAYS YOURS

No account. No sign-up, no email, no password to forget. Your habits live encrypted on your phone.

HOW IT ACTUALLY WORKS

• Some things you just do — tap once and it's done
• Some you count — a glass of water at a time, until you've had eight
• Some you sit down for — ten minutes of stretching, timed in the app
• Pick the days that are real for you: every day, weekdays, or three times a week
• Want a plan instead of a blank page? Answer a few questions and HabitScript builds you a routine — mornings, fitness, focus, reading, less phone

Give it a few weeks and something quiet happens: the months behind you fill in with color, and you can see, without counting, that you've been doing this.

PERFECT FOR

• Anyone who has deleted three habit apps already
• People who want the proof without the pressure
• Anyone starting over — again — and hoping it holds this time

FORWARD-LOOKING SCORING

Yesterday is done. Every morning is resets to a fresh 100% opportunity, so one bad day never drags you down, and you never need to wait for a new week, month, or year to begin again.

DAILY 100% TARGET

MORE FEATURES

SUPPORT GROUPS

SMART REMINDERS

REVIEW & GET INSPIRED

Clear charts, history, and streaks show how far you've come and where to improve. Progress you can actually see.

Plus dark mode, and sign in with Apple, Google, Facebook, or email.

WHY WE BUILT IT

We spent 18 years trying every habit app and always returning to a clunky spreadsheet, because none matched how real change actually works. Ever Better was built to finally replace that spreadsheet, and like the habits it tracks, it keeps getting ever better.

We hope you find it as helpful as we have.

Change the unhealthy lifestyle you’ve always wanted to change. Join our community of millions of happy routiners that are building healthy routines, breaking bad habits, & feeling more accomplished and mentally stronger by creating healthier lifestyles. Everyone wants balance & stability in their life. Streakster helps you achieve it one day at a time.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

We’ve all seen new years resolutions fail. You start the year with a ton of inspiration, but by week three you’re struggling to stay on track. You can’t rely on inspiration alone! Streakster makes it simple. We’ll give you a daily plan, remind you, and track what you accomplish. With Streakster’s routine planning you can turn that inspiration into real life changes that last.

Each morning, open the app to see your daily, weekly, and monthly habit routines. All you have to do is start! We’ll track your habit completion rate & track number of completed days. Each completed day adds to your streak, and motivates you to get your streak higher. Email support@bickster.com with any questions and we'd love to tell you more.

CAN YOU REALLY IMPROVE YOUR LIFE BY USING STREAKSTER?

Absolutely. Experts agree that building a healthy daily routine is the best way to feel accomplished and motivated. Studies show a consistent routine has many more physical and mental health benefits than other self care strategies out there today. Streakster uses tested behavioral science to remind and motivate you, helping you succeed during your self-improvement journey.

IS STREAKSTER THE APP I’VE BEEN LOOKING FOR?

Yes. Our self-improvement app is great for people who love a routine and for those new to a regular routine. All you need is your motivation to change your lifestyle and your commitment to follow a routine.

HOW TO SUCCEED WITH STREAKSTER

According to self-care researchers, people who set a smaller number of 1 or 2 habit goals to start with, and consistently reach them, were significantly more successful than those who try to drastically change their routine all at once. The key is getting small, reachable wins that build confidence. As you build up a streak, then add in another habit. As the weeks pass, you’ll realize you’ve created better habits and a long lasting healthy routine.

CONSISTENT ROUTINE = CONSISTENT STABILITY

Have you ever wanted to change your lifestyle, but after a few days you got too busy, unmotivated, or just forgot? Using the app is simple, motivation is not. One burst of inspiration isn’t enough to make changes to your life you’ve always wanted. That’s why we decided to make a self-improvement app that helps keep you motivated, tracks your progress, and most importantly reminds you of the goals you committed to. Start each day with a plan that will help you reach your goals. 

5 STAR REVIEWS

Now I'm also 3 weeks in to not playing video games! The streak aspect definitely makes a difference because once you have a streak going, you don't want to break it."

"Using this app to make a morning routine - and stick to it! - has had a huge impact on my life. I’m happier, more organized, and start every day with a feeling of accomplishment. I seriously think it helped me get a promotion at work. Current streak - 45 days!"

Three-tier targets - a full, a reduced and a minimum version of every habit

Skip the rigid counting and yes/no checkboxes. HabitLess lets you track with ranges like low, moderate, high—or create custom tags that match your life. Reduce gradually with tracking that makes sense for each habit.

FLEXIBLE TRACKING THAT FITS YOUR LIFE

Most habit apps force you into binary thinking: did you do it or not? But real habits don't work that way. HabitLess gives you three ways to track, so you can match the method to the habit.

Choose how you want to track:

- Numbers — For things you can count. Set a daily limit like "max 3 coffees" or "no more than 5 cigarettes". Log the actual number each day.

- Ranges — For things that are hard to quantify. How much sugar did you have today? You can't count it precisely, but you know if it was None, Low, Moderate, or High. Ranges let you track without overthinking.

- Custom tags — Create your own levels for habits that need specific brackets. Perfect for screen time: set up "less than 30 min", "1-2 hours", "more than 2 hours" and pick which one fits your day.

GRADUAL REDUCTION, NOT COLD TURKEY

Set targets that challenge you without setting you up to fail. Staying at "Low" counts as success. Logging "1-2 hours" when your target is "less than 30 min" shows you where you are—not that you failed. Progress happens when tracking reflects reality.

Screen time and phone scrolling. Caffeine and energy drinks. Sugar and snacking. Alcohol and drinking. Smoking and vaping. Fast food and delivery apps. Social media. Gaming. Whatever habit you want to reduce, HabitLess adapts to how you experience it.
